display_long_description:
**Congratulations, you've been promoted! Your room is now a space highway, and YOU are the newest  galactic traffic controller**

Route ships 🚀, avoid crashes 💥, destroy enemies 👾, and navigate cosmic obstacles 🎯 to get high scores.

[media]

# Features...
- **Hand Tracking**: Pinch ships, draw paths, grab asteroids & pull apart cosmablobs with your hands!

- **Leaderboards**: Chase new high scores in the Galactic Traffic Controller leaderboards, refreshed monthly to keep all employees on their toes.

- **Room Sense**: Your walls, floor, ceiling, and furniture are part of the game. Route ships coming from your walls and smash asteroids on your couch.

# Mini & VR Modes
- Play **seated** or standing with **mini mode!**
- Play in classic **passthrough** *or* immerse yourself completely with **VR mode**

[media]
# Stations Galore
Play the game with different stations to change up your work day.
- **Wall Station**: Place the portals and your station somewhere in your room!
- **Blackhole Station**: Inconvenient, but we persevere! Route your ships into the station as best you can. Just mind the gravity well.
- **One Portal Station**: Budget cuts hit hard. You only get one portal for all your ships! Traffic might get busy.
